name: web-page-not-found-with-icon-tile-search-field-and-underlined-home-link
title: White 'Page not found' with a magnifier-x icon tile, a wide search field, a black Search button and an arrow 'Go back home' link
whatItIs: A centred white page with a soft rounded icon tile holding a magnifier with an x, a big bold black 'Page not found', a grey two-line hint 'Try searching below.', a bordered search input, a full-width black Search button and an underlined link with a left arrow 'Go back home'.
whatItMeans: Helpful and calm; giving a search field turns a dead end into a next step.
techniques: Offer search on an error page.
Use a soft icon tile as the only graphic.
Use a black primary and a text link secondary.

vocabulary.definition: Offering search when a page is missing.
A rounded square with a symbol.
A link back to the home page with an arrow.
Elements stacked on one vertical axis.
